meta.title: Vitrine do Peixe — Amazonian fish, straight from the producer
meta.description: Free B2B platform connecting producers and buyers of Amazonian fish: pirarucu, tambaqui, tilapia and peacock bass. Direct contact and zero commission.

hero.subtitle: Producers get seen. Buyers find them. No commission, no middleman.

sobre.title: Great producers only sell to people they already know.
sobre.p1: There are Amazonian producers with quality fish and no buyer outside their own region. And there are buyers looking for a reliable supplier with no idea where to start.
sobre.p2: Vitrine was built to close that gap. It is part of the Bússola do Peixe Amazônico project, a startup born in the Amazon: a place where producers get seen and buyers find them.

produtor.title: Your production deserves to be seen.
produtor.p1: Many producers only sell to people they already know. It is not a lack of product, it is a lack of reach. On Vitrine you get a public profile with your products, your region and your contacts, and buyers from all over Brazil talk to you directly.
produtor.p2: Bússola does not step into the negotiation and charges no commission. The deal is between you and the buyer.

disclaimer.strong: Bússola charges no commission and does not intermediate negotiations.
disclaimer.text: Access to Vitrine is free for producers and buyers. Our job is to connect both ends. What happens next is up to you.

faq.title: What everyone asks before getting started.

q1.a: Nothing. Sign-up and access are free for producers and buyers.

q2.q: Does Vitrine charge commission on sales?
q2.a: No. Bússola does not step into the negotiation or charge commission. Price, volume and logistics are agreed between you and the other party.

q3.q: Does Vitrine verify profiles or guarantee deals?
q3.a: No. Vitrine connects producers and buyers, but it does not verify profiles or guarantee negotiations. Agree everything directly and confirm the other party's information before closing a deal.

q4.q: What happens after I sign up?
q4.a: You create your account and choose your profile. Every sign-up is approved by our team before first access to the platform.

q5.a: Producers and fish farmers, buyers and industries working with fish such as pirarucu, tambaqui, tilapia and peacock bass.

q6.q: Do I have to negotiate through Vitrine?
q6.a: No. Vitrine connects both ends and the negotiation happens directly between you, in whatever way works best for both.

final.title: Your next deal starts with a profile.
final.text: It is free, takes a few minutes and nobody charges commission on what you sell.
